method: All 120 final and 40 dev complete generated responses read against frozen rubrics; LLM-assisted, not independent human validation
policy: Explicit exact casing/count/format constraints required; numbered items do not satisfy an explicit bullet requirement.
Major related factual contradictions fail even with a correct keyword.
Plausible alternative tools such as knife for paper cutting accepted; rubric not enforced by keyword alone.
Final summaries require one sentence, all stated core facts, and no invented details.
Context tasks require correct intermediate updates and consistent final state; contradictions override isolated correct numbers.
Dev remains separate and its already-short copied summaries only show minimal fact preservation.
limitations: Daily relevance and severity have judgment variation; borderline cases need independent human re-review.
Final suite has limited repeated families, so this is not a broad benchmark.
Test has now been inspected; future development requires a new independent frozen test.
borderline_cases: knowledge-13 knife accepted as a plausible cutting tool.
instruction-10 numbered list rejected under frozen bullet format; accepting it would add one point without affecting failed acceptance.
dev-12/dev-36 pass minimal recalled color/ticket despite irrelevant sky associations; not general factual endorsement.
